title: LOOKSMAXXING for the modern male (attitude, skin & hair routine, clothes, mewing
summary: NH's no-cost looksmaxxing guide for men. Lifting is 80% of it, followed by attitude, posture and taking up space, then simple routines for hair, scent, skin, teeth, sun and clothes. He tells viewers to train the neck for the face, dismisses jawsizers, jelqing and cosmetic surgery, and says mewing is just the tongue's natural resting position.
claims: The idea that looks don't matter was invented by unattractive people as a cope; anyone can improve how they look
Nothing in real looksmaxxing requires paying anyone; it takes effort and strategy
Lifting is about 80% of looksmaxxing; hair and skin routines are pointless if you don't lift
No natural lifter would look better with less muscle
Grooming and clothes are buffs on your base stats; your body is the base stat
Looks advice from genetically gifted people doesn't transfer to average people
Obsessing over looks consumes you, and NH sees heavy appearance focus as unmasculine
Attitude matters most after the body: neediness and self-pity make you unattractive, while confidence attracts
NH attributes his acceptance into a prestigious school to sitting upright with eye contact while other candidates slouched
Take up space with open, relaxed body language; NH believes open postures may even improve your hormonal profile, though it isn't proven
Wash your hair only 2-3 times a week, use a natural shampoo for one wash in three, and rinse with cold water; frequent washing makes hair greasier
Hair gel, coloring and harsh products tire and kill hair; scalp health drives hair loss
Creatine can speed hair loss in some people, as can stress and harsh shampoos
If people can smell your perfume when you enter a room, you are wearing too much
Shave your armpits and go easy on deodorant; use a natural deodorant or a mint and lemon mix
Body odor is tied to diet: too much saturated fat, junk food or spices makes you smell
A little natural male musk (pheromones) is attractive; you don't need to smell like a flower
NH keeps all body hair except his back; if you shave, use an electric razor
Use a natural bar soap and let your own scent be your signature instead of a common chemical perfume
Prefer cold showers, which tighten the skin
As a teen NH smothered his skin in creams and it got worse; it cleared once he stopped, since skin depends largely on diet
Skin oiliness follows ancestry; NH has naturally oily skin and has never needed moisturizer
Drink plenty of water and sleep enough; NH's skin degrades when he sleeps less
Hairstyle is about 40% of looksmaxxing; experiment and learn to cut your own hair
NH shaves the sides and back and pushes the longer top to the side, which lengthens and slims the face
NH's face looked much worse when he started the channel because of water retention and fat, not bone structure
Cutting dairy removed NH's facial bloat at the same bodyweight; if you have unexplained bloat, try cutting dairy
For teeth, avoid sugar, coffee, tea, cigarettes and soda; don't whiten unless necessary; get calcium and vitamin D and brush
A natural tan is attractive; build sun tolerance progressively, e.g. 20 then 25, 30, 35 minutes, like progressive overload
Many sunscreens disrupt hormones; limit your sun exposure instead of spending hours in the sun under sunscreen
Wear comfortable clothes; a too-tight shirt on a small guy looks constricted, because muscle should be what makes the sleeve tight
Tailored clothes, especially jeans, are worth it for a muscular body
Growing the neck is the most important thing for facial aesthetics and fixes a 'wimp skull' look
Jawsizers are useless and may cause jaw problems (TMJ) because they only train closing; chew natural gum if anything
Mewing is just the tongue's natural resting position against the palate, so do it, though NH has no data on whether it changes adult faces
Jelqing is pointless and risky, because the penis isn't a muscle; size is mostly a male obsession
Avoid cosmetic surgery: it doesn't fix insecurities because you didn't work for it
Male aging is anabolic if you keep lifting; most men hit their physical prime around 40-45
